recommendedTextbook.title: Junior Secondary Agricultural Science for Nigerian Schools Book 1
recommendedTextbook.author: Anthony Youdeowei, S. O. Ayanlaja, C. C. Agwubike
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Meaning and Importance of Agriculture to Nigeria
subtopics: Branches: Crop production, animal husbandry, soil science, agricultural economics
Importance: Food, shelter, raw materials, employment, foreign exchange
objectives: Explain 5 contributions of agriculture to the Nigerian GDP
State advantages and disadvantages of shifting cultivation
Identify major commercial plantations in Nigeria

topics.topic: Classification of Crops by Life Cycle and Uses
subtopics: Food crops: Cereals, legumes, root and tuber crops
Cash and industrial crops: Oil, fiber, beverage, spice crops
objectives: Classify common crops into annual, biennial, and perennial groups
Give 3 examples of Nigerian cereal and tuber crops
Explain industrial uses of cocoa, rubber, and oil palm

topics.topic: Parts of a Flowering Crop Plant and Their Functions
subtopics: Root system: Taproot vs fibrous root
Shoot system: Stem, leaf, flower, seed, fruit
objectives: Distinguish taproot from fibrous root systems
Draw and label parts of a typical crop plant (maize / bean)
State functions of roots, stems, and leaves in crop growth

topics.topic: Simple Farm Tools: Uses and Maintenance
subtopics: Cutting and digging tools: Cutlass, hoe, spade, shovel
Gathering tools: Rake, wheelbarrow, watering can
Maintenance: Cleaning, sharpening, greasing, proper storage
objectives: State exact agricultural uses of each tool
Demonstrate cleaning, drying, and sharpening of farm cutlasses and hoes
